    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_arms

    Zigzags with two arms: BO13a figure 9.4 #

    The diagram: an arm x₀ → M₀ → E₀ with s₀ : M₀ → z p; the zigzag σ (p+j) (j < L), ρ (p+j+1) (j < L) from z p to z (p+L); an arm x (p+L+1) → M → E with s' : M → z (p+L). It is an orientation of D̃₂ₗ₊₆ (RayCat.ZAA).
